value.rationale: Acan’s fixed-number asymptotic Poisson laws motivate exact dependence across the entire increasing vector of n chord lengths. The result resolves all n-dimensional second-order dependencies and strict signs, identifies the rank defect and two nonzero eigenvalues, and gives a sharp variance identity and condition number below 2 for every n; these are natural structural information not recoverable from marginal or fixed-k limits.
